notes: Shopify store (thepurpleturtles.com, www redirects 301 to bare domain). Tier 1 (direct HTTP: robots.txt, sitemap.xml, sitemap_collections_1.xml, and /collections/<handle>/products.json) was sufficient and fully reliable; no Playwright/Chrome needed. robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow (general 'Allow: /' with only standard private-path blocks). Enumerated all ~95 collection handles from sitemap_collections_1.xml, plus total catalog size (~2444 products, summed from the 3 product sitemaps) as the denominator for the >20-30% red-flag check. Every holiday/festival-named or festive-sounding collection was fetched via /collections/<handle>/products.json (paginated) and its product list content-verified (titles + tags), not just trusted by URL/title, per the Mother's-Day-mislabeling lesson from a prior batch. Findings: DIWALI (collections/diwali) is genuine: 341 total products (250 on page1 + 91 on page2, page3 empty), og:title 'Diwali', ~86% (294/341) of products carry an explicit 'Diwali' product tag (diyas-adjacent decor, festive glassware/barware, gift bags/wraps, cushion covers, candles), and 341/2444 ~= 14% of the catalog -- well under the inflation red-flag threshold. INCLUDED. CHRISTMAS DECOR (collections/christmas-decor) is genuine but tiny: only 3 products total, linked in the current main site nav, og:title 'Christmas Decor'; 2 of 3 products explicitly tagged Christmas/Christmas Decor (Nickel/Gold ornament sets), the 3rd is an untagged scented candle plausibly bundled as a gift add-on. INCLUDED (qty 3). EXCLUDED after content verification: 'christmas-collection' (collections/christmas-collection, 45 products, og:title 'Christmas Decor For Home | Christmas Tree Online') -- only 2/45 products carry any Christmas tag, the other 43 are generic reed diffusers and fragrance candles with no holiday tag at all; this is a generic candle/diffuser catalog mislabeled under a Christmas-sounding handle, matching the exact prior-batch mistake pattern. 'christmas' (collections/christmas, 75 products, og:title 'Christmas') -- 0/75 products carry a Christmas tag; the large majority (53/75) are actually tagged 'Diwali'/'Festive' (barware, wine glasses, votives) -- this is a mislabeled generic bar-accessories collection, not Christmas content. 'new-year', 'holi', 'eid-ul-fitr', 'rakshabandhan' (collections/new-year, /holi, /eid-ul-fitr, /rakshabandhan) -- all four return the byte-for-byte IDENTICAL 16-product list in identical order (verified via product-id comparison); none of those 16 products carry a New Year/Holi/Eid/Raksha Bandhan tag (they are generic gift vouchers, Christmas ornaments, gift bags/wraps, tea lights, and metal lotus collectibles tagged only Diwali/Festive/Festive Gifts). A nonsense slug (/collections/totally-nonsense-slug-xyz123/products.json) correctly returned an empty product list, proving these are real, distinct Shopify collections rather than auto-generated search-alias pages -- but their content is a generic fallback assortment with zero holiday-specific curation for any of the four named occasions, so none qualify as genuine per-holiday categories. 'festive-gifts' (60 products), 'festive-gifting' (23 products, in main nav), 'get-gifting' (124 products, in main nav), 'gifting' (8 products), 'spotlight-festive-gifting' (3 products) -- all generic gifting/occasion catalogs (candles, photo frames, furniture, gift boxes) spanning multiple or no specific holidays (tag mix of 'festive'/'diwali' at 45-63%, never a single named occasion); 'festive' alone is not one of the target holidays, so these were excluded as generic gift-occasion pages, not holiday-specific PLPs. 'festive-sale' (2 products) and any '*-sale'/'*-back-order' handles were excluded as storewide sale/clearance pages per the boundary rules. 'a-festival-of-mirrors' (121 products, tag 'FOM2025', all product_type 'Mirrors') is a marketing campaign name ('A Festival of Mirrors') for a themed mirror sale, not an actual cultural/religious holiday -- excluded. Checked specifically and found ABSENT after full sitemap+nav+keyword search: Halloween, Thanksgiving, Easter, Valentine's Day, Mother's Day, Father's Day, and other Indian festivals (Navratri, Dussehra, Ganesh Chaturthi, Pongal, Karva Chauth, Independence Day, Baisakhi, Onam) -- zero matches in sitemap_collections_1.xml (grep across all ~95 handles/titles) or homepage nav. Current site nav (fetched Sept 2026, off-season for Diwali which falls later in the year) links only 'christmas-decor' and generic 'festive-gifting'/'get-gifting' among festive-sounding handles; 'diwali' itself is not currently nav-linked but the collection page is live, populated, and content-verified as described above, so it is included on taxonomy + content evidence rather than nav-link evidence alone.

rows.evidence: og:title 'Diwali'; enumerated via products.json pagination (250 + 91 = 341, page3 empty); ~86% (294/341) of products carry an explicit 'Diwali' product tag (festive glassware/barware, gift bags & wraps, cushion covers, decorative candles, collectibles); 341/2444 (~14%) of total catalog, well below the inflated-generic-catalog red-flag threshold.

og:title 'Christmas Decor'; linked in current main site nav; products.json shows 3 total products, 2 of which are explicitly tagged Christmas/Christmas collection/Christmas Decor (Nickel and Gold ornament sets); 3rd product is an untagged scented candle likely bundled as a gift add-on.
